tldr: Mars in Cancer: action is protective, emotional, and indirect when unsafe.
body: With Mars in Cancer, drive is motivated by care, loyalty, and the need to defend what matters. Mars is in fall here, so anger can turn sideways until it is named directly.
gift: Protective courage, tenacity, emotional motivation, and fierce devotion.
challenge: Passive aggression, defensiveness, and acting from hurt before you admit you are hurt.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
